public_rationale: The reporting confirms that Anthropic promoted expected Q3 profitability on an adjusted operating basis. It does not establish that the profit was fake or that economics worsened. The reported exclusions from gross margin cannot simply be transferred to operating income. The complete accusation therefore remains unsettled.
limitations: The investor communication is established through reporting, not an accessible original presentation.
This is an assessment of the factual accusation, not the speaker’s choice of rhetoric.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic's economics may have worsened in 2026, as shown by its use of adjusted margins to fake a Q3 2026 profit.

statement.excerpt: there are reasons to believe that things have gotten worse, such as the fact that it has resorted to using adjusted margins as a means of faking a “profit” in Q3 2026.

our_interpretation: The checkable core is that Anthropic presented Q3 profitability using adjustments that concealed an otherwise unprofitable result.
The suggestion that economics worsened is hedged. It is not a firm commitment that every measure deteriorated.
Using an adjusted measure alone does not establish deception or deterioration.
The target is Q3 2026, explicitly named in the claim. The claim concerns a presentation already made, even though the quarter had not ended when the post appeared.
The accounting basis is classified as estimate because the underlying investor communication was reported by the press.
criteria.support_condition: A contemporaneous investor presentation and a matching Q3 reconciliation establish that Anthropic represented itself as profitable only by excluding material expenses, with evidence that the presentation obscured this distinction. Comparable unadjusted results would separately establish deterioration.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The actual presentation and matching Q3 results establish ordinary profitability without the disputed exclusions, or establish that the alleged profitability representation was not made.
